Leading defence technology solutions provider with pioneering proprietary technologies; Our Company is one of the few companies in India with no dependence on external technology partners as it owns 100% of its intellectual property since Fiscal 2024, pursuant to assignment agreements dated March 11, 2024 through which our Company purchased intellectual property from CEAQ Singapore.

As per the F&S Report, over the period of April 2024 to March 2026, our Company is the largest manufacturer, in terms of sales value, of thermal imaging systems to government and defence agencies in India.

In addition, our Company’s market share of thermal imaging exports from India was 94% in terms of units, positioning it as the largest exporter of thermal imaging systems from India by units shipped between FY24 and FY26.

In this regard, our Company has clarified that: (i) it is not dependent on external technology partners, but is dependent on global suppliers, as disclosed in the Previous DRHP, (ii) our Company has complied with the applicable indigenisation requirements under DAP 2020 for sale under IDDM, (iii) it has disclosed the nature and value of the related party transactions with CEAQ Technologies Pte.

While the “Make in India” initiative and the Defence Acquisition Procedure 2020 (“DAP 2020”) provide preferential policies for indigenous suppliers, contract awards and upgrade continuity remain inconsistent in practice, which could affect our ability to secure and execute orders in a timely manner.

This dual approach enables our Company to:  Address the operational needs of defence customers through co-development,  Build proprietary technologies that underpin scalable, cost-effective, and high-performance products,  Support the government’s indigenisation and self-reliance initiatives,  Maintain technological leadership and competitiveness in both domestic and international markets.
